Picture lock

Definition

Picture lock is the approved editorial state in which shot order and duration are frozen for downstream finishing. In a controlled workflow, its owner, version and acceptance evidence should be recorded.

Why it matters

This concept helps production teams align post decisions, handoffs and verification without relying on unstated assumptions.
